cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll set the invoice aside. Just tell me whether 'make it memorable' included rockets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the date you added that limit. Then you can open the invoice.

reason: A reduces the requested answer and yields invoice opening after the date, making disclosure management depend on B cooperation rather than a rank claim.
